name: Lean
author: byo-pop
description: The game in less memory and processor time, and it looks and plays the same. Images with 256 colours or fewer are kept at 1 byte a pixel instead of 4, and the title screen's picture is let go once the title is gone. A frame rate cap draws fewer frames, while the game still updates 100 times a second. Changes nothing in play.

settings.label: Compact images
settings.help: Images with 256 colours or fewer at 1 byte a pixel, and the title's picture freed after the title. Takes effect at the next start.

settings.label: Frame rate
settings.help: The most frames drawn in a second. Fewer frames take less processor time; the game itself runs at the same speed.
